changelog: One-click library setup: a "Create the Retro TV library" button on the settings page creates the Jellyfin library from the output folder (mixed movies + TV) — no manual library step, and the library shows the Retro TV icon automatically (the catalog build writes it into the folder). Everything from 0.3.0.1 is unchanged (Getting-started box, copyable tuner links, one-click theme apply to Branding).
description: Turns the Internet Archive into a retro-video library and live channels inside Jellyfin.
name: Retro TV
overview: Retro TV — Saturday-morning cartoons, classic TV, drive-in movies and more, from the Internet Archive.
